finalReport.rawFindings:
--- CRITICAL FINDINGS ---

[AI-1] Uncached server-side Perplexity calls
File: src/app/api/perplexity/query/route.ts (L1-L200)
Evidence: The route forwards every POST directly to Perplexity via fetch (stream: false) and is marked dynamic='force-dynamic' with no response cache, dedupe, or rate-limit logic. This means every user request issues an external LLM call.  
Impact: Cost and external-API usage grow linearly and unbounded with traffic (per-request billing); latency also scales with external calls.  
Fix: Add a response cache (Redis/edge) keyed by query+model, debounce/dedupe in-flight identical requests, and enforce per-user rate limits.

[AI-2] Client-selectable expensive models with no quotas
File: src/services/perplexityService.ts + src/components/PerplexityChat.tsx (L1-L200)
Evidence: The client sends a chosen model id to the server (PERPLEXITY_MODELS includes high-cost models like sonar-deep-research/sonar-pro) and the server accepts VALID_MODELS without tracking usage, costs, or enforcing model-to-plan restrictions.  
Impact: Cost grows linearly but with very high per-call unit cost and no caps — a few heavy requests can cause large bills (effectively unbounded spend).  
Fix: Enforce server-side model-to-plan mappings, per-user/model quotas and counters, and auto-fallback to cheaper models when quotas are exceeded.

[AI-3] No semantic/TTL cache or dedupe for repeated queries
File: src/app/api/perplexity/query/route.ts (L1-L200)
Evidence: Identical queries are re-sent to Perplexity on each request with no hashing/semantic cache or TTL, and no mechanism to collapse concurrent identical requests.  
Impact: Cost grows linearly with redundant traffic (e.g., bots, repeated UI polls, or many users asking the same question), magnifying spend unnecessarily.  
Fix: Implement a hash-based semantic cache (Redis/edge) with sensible TTLs and in-flight request coalescing to reuse single API responses.

--- WARNING FINDINGS ---

[AI-4] No streaming — client waits for full responses
File: src/components/PerplexityChat.tsx (L1-L400)
Evidence: queryPerplexity POSTs to /api/perplexity/query and the server calls Perplexity with stream: false; the client waits for the full JSON response before rendering assistant text.  
Impact: Perceived latency and blocked UI scale with model response time (worse UX under load), though direct cost is unchanged.  
Fix: Use streaming APIs or SSE/ReadableStream in the server route and progressively render partial responses to the client.

--- INFO ---

[AI-5] Pro-plan gating exists but lacks enforcement features
File: src/app/api/perplexity/query/route.ts (L1-L200)
Evidence: The route checks user.isPro before allowing calls, which reduces surface area but doesn't limit per-user consumption or cost exposure.
